dimensions.name: Strain Specificity
dimensions.description: Are specific probiotic strains named (Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium, etc.) with strain-level detail?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No strains. 3: Generic 'probiotic blend'. 5: Genus-level naming. 7: Species-level naming with count. 10: Full strain-level identification (e.g. L. acidophilus LA-5) with clinically studied strains noted.

dimensions.name: CFU Count & Potency
dimensions.description: Is the CFU count clearly stated with guaranteed-at-expiry vs at-manufacture distinction?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No CFU. 3: Just a number. 5: CFU per capsule stated. 7: CFU with 'at time of manufacture' noted. 10: Guaranteed CFU at expiry date with overage explanation.

dimensions.name: Delivery Technology
dimensions.description: Is delayed-release, enteric coating, or acid-resistant capsule technology mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'Capsule'. 5: 'Veggie capsule'. 7: Delayed-release or acid-resistant mentioned. 10: Specific delivery tech explained with survival rate or stomach acid protection data.

dimensions.name: Targeted Benefits
dimensions.description: Are specific health outcomes targeted (bloating, IBS, immunity, women's health, gut-brain)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: Generic 'digestive health'. 3: One vague benefit. 5: 2-3 specific benefits. 7: Targeted benefits for specific conditions. 10: Multi-benefit positioning with audience segmentation.

dimensions.name: Prebiotic Inclusion
dimensions.description: Is a prebiotic component included and explained?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'With prebiotics'. 5: Prebiotic type named. 7: Prebiotic explained with synbiotic benefit. 10: Specific prebiotic (inulin, FOS) with dosage and symbiotic mechanism explained.

dimensions.name: Shelf Stability
dimensions.description: Is shelf stability, storage requirements, and no-refrigeration-needed clearly communicated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'Store in cool place'. 5: 'No refrigeration needed'. 7: Shelf-stable technology explained. 10: Specific shelf-stable tech with stability testing data.

dimensions.name: Allergen & Dietary Callouts
dimensions.description: Are dairy-free, gluten-free, vegan, soy-free, no artificial ingredients stated?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: One callout. 5: 2-3 callouts. 7: Comprehensive. 10: Full allergen statement critical for probiotic buyers.

dimensions.name: Clinical Backing
dimensions.description: Are clinical studies, doctor-recommended, or research references mentioned?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: 'Scientifically formulated'. 5: 'Clinically studied strains'. 7: Specific study referenced. 10: Named clinical studies with outcomes data.

dimensions.name: Keyword Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the listing include category-relevant search terms used by top competitors?

dimensions.name: Trust Signals
dimensions.description: Are GMP, third-party tested, doctor-formulated, satisfaction guarantee present?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 5: Basic signals. 10: Comprehensive trust framework.
